lead.tldr: X’s Cashtags feature generated $1 billion volume in two days, confirming strong appetite for integrated crypto trading • Coinbase Ventures highlights tokenisation, specialised exchanges, next‑gen DeFi and AI as 2026 focus, targeting $20 trillion market by 2030 • Kelp DAO’s $293.7 million rsETH hack triggers market freeze, underscoring systemic risk in liquid restaking protocols • Iran’s Strait of Hormuz closure pushes Bitcoin and Ethereum down 2‑3%, reviving geopolitical volatility concerns

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, a $300 m exploit on Kelp DAO highlights lingering security risks while Iran’s Strait of Hormuz shutdown nudged Bitcoin and Ethereum lower. Meanwhile X’s new Cashtags generated $1 billion of trading, underscoring appetite for integrated finance.

top_signals.title: Hackers target DeFi protocol Kelp DAO in massive $300m exploit
top_signals.summary: Hackers drained approximately $293.7 million worth of rsETH from the Ethereum‑based liquid restaking protocol Kelp DAO. The breach was first identified by analyst ZachXBT and the stolen assets were subsequently transferred across Ethereum, Arbitrum and a Tornado Cash mixer. In response, Aave froze rsETH markets to contain further exposure. The exploit triggered a sharp decline in the price of rsETH and related tokens, highlighting systemic risk for institutional exposure to liquid restaking platforms.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum slide after Iran says Strait of Hormuz is shut
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin and Ethereum fell 2‑3% after reports that Iran had closed the Strait of Hormuz, reviving geopolitical risk concerns. In the same week, crypto exchange‑traded funds recorded strong institutional inflows, with Bitcoin‑focused funds drawing close to $1 billion. Ethereum‑focused funds attracted roughly $276 million of new capital. The price movement underscores the market’s sensitivity to developments in U.S., Iran cease‑fire negotiations, a factor institutional investors monitor closely.

top_signals.title: X’s Cashtags Feature Drives $1B Trading Volume
top_signals.summary: X introduced a smart Cashtags feature that displays real‑time stock and cryptocurrency information within its platform. The tool also enables Canadian users to execute trades directly through a partnership with Wealthsimple. Within the first two days of launch, the feature generated approximately $1 billion in trading volume. The rapid uptake signals strong demand from the platform’s user base for integrated financial services and may attract institutional interest in the ecosystem.

top_signals.title: Coinbase's VC arm reveals the trends crypto investors are betting on in 2026
top_signals.summary: Coinbase Ventures principal Jonathan King identified four key investment themes for 2026: tokenisation, specialised exchanges, next‑gen DeFi and AI. He said the crypto market is moving into a “builders” phase even though Q1 venture funding fell 15% year‑over‑year to just under $5 billion. Despite the short‑term funding dip, King highlighted a long‑term growth outlook, pointing to a projected $20 trillion tokenisation market by 2030. Institutional investors may view these themes as the primary drivers of capital allocation as the sector seeks to scale infrastructure and new use cases.

top_signals.title: Worldcoin Falls 13% as World Expands Iris-Scanning Tech
top_signals.summary: Worldcoin’s native token WLD fell 13% to $0.28 as the project expanded its iris‑scanning identity verification technology to new partners including AWS, Shopify and Coinbase. The rollout adds an account‑based system that enables key recovery for users. The move highlights the growing relevance of biometric identity solutions for digital finance while also drawing scrutiny over the privacy implications of large‑scale biometric data collection.

A massive exploit hit the liquid restaking protocol Kelp DAO, draining close to $294 million of rsETH. The breach, first spotted by analyst ZachXBT, saw the stolen assets move through Ethereum, Arbitrum and even a Tornado Cash mixer. Aave’s swift decision to freeze rsETH markets helped limit further exposure, yet the episode underscores the systemic risk that liquid restaking platforms can pose for institutional portfolios. At the same time, macro‑geopolitical tension resurfaced when reports emerged that Iran had closed the Strait of Hormuz. Bitcoin and Ethereum slipped 2‑3 percent as investors weighed the potential impact on global trade routes. Despite the dip, crypto‑focused exchange‑traded funds attracted nearly $1 billion of fresh capital for Bitcoin strategies and $276 million for Ethereum, highlighting that institutional money remains hungry for exposure even amid uncertainty. On the product side, X’s new Cashtags feature is reshaping how retail participants interact with markets. By delivering real‑time price data and enabling direct trades through a partnership with Wealthsimple, the tool generated roughly $1 billion of trading volume in just two days. The rapid adoption signals a strong appetite for integrated financial services and could open new pathways for institutional partners to reach a broader audience.
